description: An example pack, all original: the Lamplighter class with its own Ember Dice and a subclass, a new Savage Arsenal ability for the Berserker, an ancestry, a background, two spells, a magic item and a monster.

entries.name: Lamplighter
entries.tagline: A wandering keeper of small fires, holding back the dark.
entries.flavor: Every road has a stretch where the lamps went out. Lamplighters walk those stretches with a lantern, a satchel of wicks and a stubborn little fire that comes when they call.

casting.notes: You know Fire cantrips and the Lamplighter's own. At level 2 you unlock tier 1 spells and a mana pool to cast them; it recharges on a Safe Rest.

features.name: Stoke the Flame
features.text: You have WIL Ember Dice (d6). When you hit with an attack or a spell, you may expend 1 Ember Die and add it to the damage as fire damage. They come back on a Safe Rest.

features.name: Lantern Light
features.text: (1/encounter) Action: Your lantern flares. Until the end of your next turn, creatures of your choice within 4 spaces of you can see invisible things.

features.name: Spellfire
features.text: You unlock tier 1 spells and a mana pool to cast them.

features.name: Steady Hands
features.text: Advantage on checks to light, carry or shield a flame.

features.name: Brighter Embers
features.text: Your Ember Dice are now d8s.

features.name: Tier 2 Spells
features.text: You may now cast spells up to tier 2.

optionGroups.name: Kindlings
optionGroups.intro: Small tricks of the trade, learned on long nights.

options.name: Warm Hands
options.text: You and creatures you touch ignore the effects of extreme cold.

options.name: Smoke Screen
options.text: (1/encounter) Fill a 2×2 area within 6 spaces with thick smoke until the end of your next turn. It blocks sight.

options.name: Long Wick
options.text: Your Lantern Light reaches 8 spaces instead of 4.

options.name: Cinder Step
options.text: When an enemy moves next to you, move 2 spaces, leaving a trail of embers behind.

sidebars.title: Ember Dice
sidebars.text: Roll an Ember Die when you spend it, one per attack or spell. Spending one is your choice, after you know you hit.

entries.name: Keeper of the Night Watch
entries.flavor: Stand between the sleeping town and whatever walks the road at night.

features.name: Watchful
features.text: You can't be surprised while you're awake, and you wake at the first sound of trouble.

features.name: Ward the Gate
features.text: Reaction: When a creature within 2 spaces of you is attacked, expend 1 Ember Die and add it to their Armor against that attack.

entries.name: Banked Fire
entries.text: When your Rage ends, keep 1 of your Fury Dice set aside for your next Rage.

entries.name: Emberkin
entries.flavor: Small folk with warm skin and eyes like coals, said to be born beside a hearth that never went out.

traits.name: Warm Blooded
traits.text: You are resistant to cold damage, and you see in dim light as if it were bright.

entries.name: Night Watch Veteran
entries.text: You walked the walls for years. Advantage on Perception checks to stay awake or keep watch, and you know every guard's favourite excuse.

entries.name: Wickflame
entries.text: Range: 6. Damage: 1d8 fire. Or a flame you can see within range grows or shrinks to the size you choose, from a candle to a campfire.

entries.name: Lantern Ward
entries.text: Your lantern burns white. While you concentrate, enemies within 2 spaces of you have disadvantage on attacks against your allies.

entries.name: Everburning Lantern
entries.text: This brass lantern never needs oil, and wind and rain can't put it out. Once a day, its holder can speak a word to make it shine as bright as day for 1 minute.

entries.name: Wick Wraith

traits.name: Snuff
traits.text: Nonmagical flames within 4 spaces of it go out.

actions.name: Smoke Breath
actions.text: (Cone 3) 1d8+5, DEX save; on a fail, Blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.bloodied: It flickers: attacks against it have disadvantage until it's hit again.
entries.flavor: What's left of a lamplighter who let their fire go out.

tactics.easier: Use Cold Grasp on whoever is closest.
tactics.harder: Open with Smoke Breath on the heroes carrying light.
